model_meta.description: Inferred conceptual model of a mechanical hinge assembly that uses housing-driven followers, a variable-incline cam and a compression device to partially counterbalance a movable member.

subsystems.description: Housing engaged with the movable member; its cam-follower guides drive the first followers as the movable member rotates.

Holder mounted on the shaft and carrying first followers that receive guide motion and second followers that engage the cam; in disclosed configurations it rotates and moves laterally relative to the shaft.
Cam with slots or cam surfaces of varying incline, engaged by the holder's second followers to produce lateral displacement.
Biasing device acting on the follower holder to provide at least partial counterbalance; disclosed implementations include springs and non-spring alternatives.
Shaft supporting the follower holder and providing its rotation/sliding axis.

item_flows.name: Guide-to-first-follower force
item_flows.notes: Housing guide contact imparts rotation to the follower holder.

item_flows.name: Cam-to-second-follower force
item_flows.notes: Cam surface engagement drives holder laterally.

item_flows.name: Compression bias force
item_flows.notes: Compression device biases the holder and counterbalances movable-member weight.

item_flows.name: Shaft-holder mounting relationship
item_flows.notes: The holder is mounted to the shaft, which passes through its central passage (claims 7, 15, and 19).

actions.name: Drive holder and bias compression device

steps.description: Movable-member movement carries the housing and its cam-follower guides (claims 1, 15, and 20).
Housing guides drive the first cam followers and rotate the cam-follower holder (claims 1, 12, 15, and 20).
Second cam followers engage the cam slots or surfaces; varying incline drives the holder laterally against the compression-device bias (claims 1, 10, 15, 16, and 19).
Compression-device force is transmitted through the holder and cam arrangement to partially counterbalance the movable member (claims 1 and 15).

actions.name: Move movable member toward stowed position

steps.description: Housing guides drive the first followers and rotate the holder as the movable member is pushed toward stowed (method claim 22).
Second followers engage the cam surfaces and drive the holder away from the compression-device bias (method claim 22).

actions.name: Move movable member toward deployed position

steps.description: Pulling the movable member toward deployed drives the housing guides against the first followers and imparts rotation to the holder (method claim 21).
The second followers engage the cam surfaces, driving the holder laterally against the compression-device bias and further compressing the device (method claim 21).
